acceptance.given: Quick Dev has authored the source-declared S36 selector and a replay result is evaluated against its bound result-determining inputs.

oracle.expected: When a bound result-determining input differs without an approved explanation, the replay result is explicitly stale or replay terminates fail closed.
forbidden: Unexplained result-determining drift is accepted as a current valid result.
Replay silently continues after unexplained drift.
oracle.observable: The S36 real-test assertion observing stale classification or fail-closed replay for a drifted bound input.

acceptance.then: The affected replay result is stale or the operation is fail closed.
acceptance.when: Result-determining input drift is detected without an explanation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S36 real selector with one bound result-determining input changed and no approved explanation; reject any current-valid or silent-continuation outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compare reconstructed replay inputs with their bound identities and classify any unexplained result-determining difference as stale or fail closed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or Phase state changes; reverting restores prior Toolchain replay drift handling only.

slice_hint.state_transition: Bound replay result under evaluation -> unexplained bound-input drift detected -> stale result or fail-closed replay.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S36 selector demonstrates that unexplained result-determining input drift never yields a current valid result and is explicitly stale or fail closed.

acceptance.given: A test path is declared as planned but has not yet been authored and executed by Quick Dev.

oracle.expected: The evaluation records the test as planned only and does not use that declaration to establish test presence, absence, or behavior evidence.
forbidden: A planned declaration alone establishes that a test exists.
A planned declaration alone establishes present, missing, passing, or failing behavior.
oracle.observable: The S12 real-test assertion distinguishes an authored-and-executed test or fixture from a merely planned path.

acceptance.then: Planned declarations remain distinct from authored and executed test evidence.
acceptance.when: Test presence, absence, or behavior evidence is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S12 selector against a declaration-only planned test path and reject a result that treats the declaration as present or behavioral evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve the evidence-state boundary: a planned test path is feasible future work, not an existing test or behavioral observation until Quick Dev authors and executes its assertions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or Phase state changes; reverting restores the prior Toolchain compilation evidence-state behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Planned declaration encountered -> evidence-status evaluation -> planned-only status until authored real assertions execute.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S12 selector proves that declaration-only paths cannot establish test presence, absence, or behavior; only authored and executed assertions or fixture evidence can do so.

acceptance.given: A supported Windows invocation has platform-dependent behavior to evaluate through the S7 Toolchain replay path.

oracle.expected: The S7 assertion explicitly declares the applicable platform-specific behavior and rejects a user-profile path as current authority.
forbidden: Platform-specific behavior is implicit or undeclared.
A user-profile path is accepted as current authority.
oracle.observable: The authored S7 test's platform declaration assertion and its Windows/user-profile negative assertion.

acceptance.then: The declaration is explicit and the authority boundary remains enforced.
acceptance.when: The S7 Toolchain selector is executed on Windows.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s7.py rejects an omitted platform declaration or user-profile authority.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Declare platform-specific replay behavior at the Toolchain owner and make the S7 assertion reject undeclared behavior and user-profile current authority.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; removing the declaration assertion restores prior Toolchain behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: platform-specific behavior requiring declaration -> explicitly declared and authority-bounded behavior
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 selector passes only when platform-specific behavior is explicitly declared and user-profile paths cannot be current authority.

acceptance.given: A replay result is being produced or recorded and its current-state binding has not yet been established.

oracle.expected: The replay result contains or references a complete Current Snapshot that identifies all replay-relevant current state.
forbidden: Replay result is emitted without a complete Current Snapshot binding.
Replay result is bound to a partial or incomplete snapshot.
oracle.observable: During replay-result production or recording, the selected Toolchain test inspects the bound Current Snapshot manifest and its required root coverage.

acceptance.then: The produced or recorded replay result is bound to a complete Current Snapshot.
acceptance.when: A replay result is produced or recorded and the Toolchain behavior selector is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the isolated Current Snapshot selector with a missing or incomplete required snapshot root and observe deterministic rejection before a replay result can be bound as complete.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require Toolchain replay-result binding to use a complete Current Snapshot with the exact required current-state roots; reject missing or incomplete snapshot bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback preserves fail-closed rejection of incomplete Current Snapshot bindings.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay result is being produced without an established complete current-state binding -> replay result is bound to a complete Current Snapshot.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected Toolchain test verifies that a replay result can bind only a complete Current Snapshot identifying all replay-relevant current state, and that an incomplete binding is rejected.
